Bornomala commemorates 21st February
2017-02-25T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/deshi-grapevine/bornomala-commemorates-21st-february-1366672

Syed Abdul Hadi has given his voice to a new song named "Bornomala" along with Saregama Music Academy's young artists, commemorating our International Mother Language Day. The lyrics of the song was written by Mahfuz Billah Rahi. It was tuned and directed by Sheikh Sadi Khan. The song was officially published on 20th February 2017 on CD Choice's official YouTube channel and has garnered a lot of positive attention since then. "I have recently sung a new song regarding our International Mother Language Day, and all the kids form Saregama Academy who sang it are extremely talented. Through this song, our responsibility for this great day will increase furthermore", said Syed Abdul Hadi.
